description:
How has this category changed? History of the Wintraits Scan Index of a Scan category.
(¿Cómo ha cambiado esta categoría?)

For each update: middle half (25-75 %) and median of the Wintraits Scan Index of best sellers and of the rest.
If the best sellers' band rises, a listing needs to look more like them to be among them.

Args:
    categoria: Scan category id (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles).
    pais: country code (e.g. "ES").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-01-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-ene-2027).
name: wintraits_scan_historia
